title: Theme Settings

fields.label: Site Tagline (EN)
fields.name: site_tagline_en
fields.instructions: Short slogan shown in the site header/hero.

fields.label: Site Tagline (MS)
fields.name: site_tagline_ms
fields.default_value: Fokus Lebih Tajam. Perform Lebih Tinggi.

fields.label: WhatsApp Number URL
fields.name: whatsapp_number
fields.instructions: Full WhatsApp link, e.g. https://wa.me/60123456789. Used by every WhatsApp button and the checkout.

fields.message: The thin bar at the very top of every page. Long text shows on desktop, short text on mobile.

fields.label: Free Shipping Threshold
fields.name: free_shipping_threshold
fields.instructions: Reference value for the free shipping minimum, e.g. RM870. Change the trust bar text above and the Shop Page bullets to match.

fields.message: The dark banner at the top of the Shop page.

fields.label: Subtitle (EN)
fields.name: shop_hero_subtitle_en
fields.default_value: Browse and buy genuine Modafinil tablets online from certified manufacturers. Fast Malaysia-wide delivery on all orders.

fields.label: Subtitle (MS)
fields.name: shop_hero_subtitle_ms
fields.default_value: Semak dan beli tablet Modafinil asli secara dalam talian dari pengeluar bertauliah. Penghantaran pantas ke seluruh Malaysia.

fields.label: Bullet Points
fields.name: shop_hero_bullets
fields.instructions: Ticked points under the subtitle, e.g. Free Shipping Over RM870.

fields.label: Description (EN)
fields.name: footer_description_en
fields.default_value: Modafinil Malaysia provides genuine Modafinil for performance, vitality, and fast-acting results. Enjoy discreet online ordering and reliable delivery across Malaysia in 7-10 days.

fields.label: Description (MS)
fields.name: footer_description_ms
fields.default_value: Modafinil Malaysia menyediakan Modafinil asli untuk prestasi, kecergasan, dan hasil bertindak pantas. Nikmati pesanan dalam talian diskret dan penghantaran yang boleh dipercayai di seluruh Malaysia dalam 7-10 hari.

fields.label: Address (EN)
fields.name: footer_address_en
fields.default_value: Level 33, Ilham Tower No. 8, Jalan Binjai 50450 Kuala Lumpur Malaysia

fields.label: Address (MS)
fields.name: footer_address_ms
fields.default_value: Aras 33, Menara Ilham No. 8, Jalan Binjai 50450 Kuala Lumpur Malaysia

fields.label: Disclaimer (EN)
fields.name: disclaimer_en
fields.default_value: The information on this site is for educational purposes only. Modafinil is a prescription medication in Malaysia. Please consult a licensed medical practitioner before using any cognitive enhancement products.

fields.label: Disclaimer (MS)
fields.name: disclaimer_ms
fields.default_value: Maklumat yang disediakan di laman web ini adalah untuk tujuan pendidikan sahaja dan tidak boleh dianggap sebagai nasihat perubatan. Modafinil adalah ubat preskripsi di Malaysia. Sila berunding dengan pengamal perubatan berlesen sebelum menggunakan sebarang produk peningkatan kognitif.

fields.label: Trust Badges
fields.name: trust_badges
fields.instructions: Icon badges shown in the trust strip (e.g. Secure Checkout, Fast Delivery).

fields.label: Footer Badges
fields.name: footer_badges
fields.instructions: Icon badges shown in the footer.

fields.label: FAQs
fields.name: faqs_list
fields.instructions: Questions reused by the FAQ sections across the site.

fields.message: Text on the order thank-you page (shown after checkout). The bank transfer block at the bottom is hidden until the bank fields are filled in. Order emails are not controlled from here.

fields.label: Success Icon
fields.name: thankyou_icon
fields.instructions: Round icon above the heading on the thank-you page.

fields.label: Heading (EN)
fields.name: thankyou_title_en
fields.instructions: Main heading of the thank-you page.

fields.label: Intro Text (EN)
fields.name: thankyou_intro_en
fields.instructions: Line under the heading.
fields.default_value: Your order has been received and is now being processed.

fields.label: Intro Text (MS)
fields.name: thankyou_intro_ms
fields.default_value: Pesanan anda telah diterima dan sedang diproses.

fields.message: Thank-you page: payment instructions box (shown under the order summary for every order)

fields.label: Text (EN)
fields.name: payment_instructions_text_en
fields.instructions: Use {email} where the order email address should appear. It is read from Brand & Contact / Footer Email and shown as a link.
fields.default_value: * Once your payment is done, just send the transaction copy to {email} and we'll ship your order immediately.

fields.label: Text (MS)
fields.name: payment_instructions_text_ms
fields.default_value: * Selepas pembayaran dibuat, hantar salinan transaksi ke {email} dan kami akan menghantar pesanan anda dengan segera.

fields.message: Thank-you page: note box (next steps) (blue box under the payment details)

fields.label: Note: Payment Reference (EN)
fields.name: thankyou_note_reference_en
fields.instructions: You may use <strong> for bold. Leave both empty to hide this line.
fields.default_value: Please DO NOT reference anything related to medicine or website name. Just mention your order number.

fields.label: Note: Payment Reference (MS)
fields.name: thankyou_note_reference_ms
fields.default_value: Sila JANGAN menyebut apa-apa berkaitan ubat atau nama laman web. Cukup nyatakan nombor pesanan anda.

fields.label: Note: Shipping Time (EN)
fields.name: thankyou_note_shipping_en
fields.instructions: Leave both empty to hide this line.
fields.default_value: The average shipping time is 7 - 10 business days. Please note that delivery may take up to 30 days from the date of dispatch due to potential disruptions in postal services caused by weather issues or natural disaster.

fields.label: Note: Shipping Time (MS)
fields.name: thankyou_note_shipping_ms
fields.default_value: Purata masa penghantaran ialah 7 - 10 hari bekerja. Penghantaran mungkin mengambil masa sehingga 30 hari dari tarikh dihantar kerana gangguan perkhidmatan pos akibat cuaca atau bencana alam.

fields.label: Note: Site Name
fields.name: thankyou_note_site
fields.instructions: Bold line at the end of the note box. Same in both languages. Leave empty to hide.

fields.message: Thank-you page: failed payment (shown instead of the above when the order status is Failed)

fields.label: Failed Icon
fields.name: thankyou_failed_icon
fields.instructions: Round icon above the heading when payment failed.

fields.label: Text (EN)
fields.name: thankyou_failed_text_en
fields.default_value: Unfortunately your order cannot be processed as the originating bank/merchant has declined your transaction. Please attempt your purchase again.

fields.label: Text (MS)
fields.name: thankyou_failed_text_ms
fields.default_value: Maaf, pesanan anda tidak dapat diproses kerana bank atau pedagang telah menolak transaksi anda. Sila cuba buat pembelian sekali lagi.

fields.label: My Account Button (EN)
fields.name: thankyou_failed_account_en
fields.instructions: Only shown to logged-in customers.

fields.message: Bank transfer block (thank-you page, only for orders paid by bank transfer). This is the single place for bank details. If Bank Name, Account Name, Account Number and SWIFT/BIC are all empty, the whole block is hidden. Nothing is pre-filled: enter the real details here.

fields.label: Bank Name
fields.name: bank_name
fields.instructions: Name of the bank.

fields.label: Account Name
fields.name: bank_account_name
fields.instructions: Name of the account holder.

fields.label: Account Number
fields.name: bank_account_number
fields.instructions: Bank account number.

fields.label: SWIFT/BIC
fields.name: bank_swift_bic
fields.instructions: Optional. Leave empty to hide this row.

fields.label: Reference Note (EN)
fields.name: bank_reference_note_en
fields.instructions: Optional line shown under the details, for example how to write the payment reference. Leave empty to hide.

description: All site-wide content. Use the tabs on the left to switch sections, then press Update.
